Your computer is the archive.

The installed app opens in its own desktop window, with no separate browser or Python installation. Photographs and projects stay in the folder you choose. Backups and project exports let you control what you share.

A SIMPLE START

Install. Choose a folder.
Open your archive.

The desktop app guides you through choosing storage, then opens your workspace. Experiments save automatically in the archive database. Keep backups before updates; each computer’s archive is independent.

Can I use it for academic work?

Block Archive is available under PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0. See the license guidance for permitted uses. Commercial use requires a separate agreement.

Will my photos be uploaded to this website?

No. This website provides information and downloads. The application processes and stores photographs locally; it does not upload them to this website.

Can I connect it to another system?

A local API supports block-code lookup, photographs and archive records. Read the API guide for integration details.
